meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it as the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

"Your son cheated." I'm writing that down. My child never lies, so are you calling me a liar too? Your own procedure says software doesn't establish a concern, and nobody called me before that zero went in.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

"I'll have to put it on his permanent record." You just threatened my son's record because his mother asked a question. Say that again in an email, Hale, because I'm going to the principal's office when we're done, and the board after that.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record, with the principal's office next; that is not the fair outcome, which is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out first.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed her no dated document she could check.
What cost ground: You led with the detector score and called Owen a cheater, then threatened his permanent record, which is the one thing she never trades.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you offered none, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked whether anyone spoke to Owen before the zero went in, own that in one sentence, then put one dated document in front of her instead of the score.
